title: Endpoint offered over plaintext HTTP
rationale: Unreachable in the live corpus because the collectors drop non-HTTPS URLs and count them as `dropped_not_https`. The fixture exists because a branch no data exercises is a branch that can invert without anyone noticing, and this one decides whether a plaintext deployment is recorded as a violation or silently as nothing at all.

spec.quote: All authorization server endpoints MUST be served over HTTPS.
